verdict.rationale: Fedora provides general-purpose tooling (Boxes VMs, container tools, package/runtime access via single command) that developers could use to build dev environments, but there is no evidence of preconfigured, framework-specific environment templates (e.g. one-click Node/Python/Java/Rails setups) or a dedicated dev-environment tool. missing for 10: preconfigured framework/language environment templates, one-click language-specific dev container setups, independent hands-on verification of ease-of-setup for specific frameworks.
